messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@intellistream.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: Overnight throughput run — temporary top-up request

Hi Lauren,

We’re planning a focused overnight POC run to validate throughput and tail latency for our recommendation API. The test window is 08/20 01:00–09:00 PT (8 hours). Goal: sustained 250 RPS ingest (50–150 token prompts, 50 token average), with occasional short spikes to 400 RPS, to simulate our production daytime burst. We estimate ~3.6M input tokens + model output (~2.4M) ≈ 6M tokens total.

Current trial quota will cap us well below that, so request: a temporary trial credit top-up to cover ~6M tokens (or an equivalent time-limited voucher) for this isolated run. We’ll use it strictly for the scheduled window and provide final logs and a short post-run summary within 48 hours.

Attached is our test plan (intellistream-overnight-run-plan.xlsx) and a short run checklist. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provision a one-off token top-up or provide an ephemeral voucher for that window? If needed we can tighten prompts or run fewer replicas — please advise.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, IntelliStream
ops-eng@intellistream.com


From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir@intellistream.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: Overnight throughput run — temporary top-up request

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear plan and the attach. Looping in Ben (SE) and Marissa (CS) to confirm impact and the temporary top-up flow. High level: we can support an ephemeral voucher for that window, but credits above our standard trial cap require an approval sign-off.

Quick proposal from our side:
- Provision a 200k token trial top-up (usable for the specified 8-hour window) as a provisional grant while we fast-track approval for additional coverage.
- If you confirm you must hit ~6M tokens, we’ll open a short approval (internal) for an additional 4M token voucher tied to the run and require acceptance of a basic mutual action plan (attached: mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf).
- We’ll pin the voucher to your account for US-West region to reduce cross-region variance.

Ben — can you confirm whether 200k tokens will cover a minimal smoke run and whether routing to a slightly lower-cost model variant is an acceptable fallback to extend headroom? Also flag any SLO risk for the requested 400 RPS short spikes.

Samir — once Ben confirms, I’ll provision the provisional voucher and send the MAP for signature.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@intellistream.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: Overnight throughput run — temporary top-up request

Lauren / Samir — quick technical note. Thanks for the run plan, Samir — gives good granularity. A few points:

- 250 RPS sustained at ~100 tokens/req (round-trip) for 8 hours ≈ 7.2M tokens; your 6M estimate is reasonable if you reduce prompt sizes in a couple of flows.
- Short 400 RPS spikes are what drive tail latency risk. If you can limit concurrent long-sequence requests during spikes (or set a 2–3s concurrency timeout), that will keep the percentile latencies acceptable.
- Alternative to a straight token top-up: we can route the POC to a cheaper quantized model (gpt-small-q4) for the bulk of throughput, then failover to the higher-quality model for a 10% sampled traffic slice to validate quality. That would cut token spend by ~45–55% with similar latency characteristics.

Operationally I recommend:
1) Provision 200k provisional token voucher now for your smoke run (we can enable immediately).
2) If you sign the MAP, we’ll approve an ephemeral 4M token voucher for the scheduled window and place an explicit single-run throttle so credits cannot be used outside the window.

I’ll validate scheduling constraints with infra; no sustained SLA risk for an 8-hour run if we apply the model routing plan above.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Thanks Lauren / Ben — this sounds great and aligns with what we need. Two quick confirmations:

1) We accept the provisional 200k voucher for immediate smoke tests — we’ll run a 1-hour sanity pass tonight to exercise the pipeline.
2) We’re happy to sign the MAP to enable the ephemeral 4M token voucher for the 08/20 01:00–09:00 PT window. Please send the DocuSign link and confirm the voucher will be restricted to the US-West region and the account-id ops@intellistream.com.

We’ll also plan to adopt the quantized model fallback for 90% of traffic during the soak if that materially improves headroom; Ben, I’ll coordinate with your team on the sampling config.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, IntelliStream
samir@intellistream.com
